name: SCHEDULE_VERSION is exported at runtime and matches this suite
gist: SCHEDULE_VERSION — the constant this suite executes; a clause change without a bump fails here.

name: clause 1: bare write = synchronous batch of one; Object.is-equal write emits nothing
gist: Clause 1 — a bare write is a SYNCHRONOUS batch of one; central Object.is no-op drop.

name: clause 2: mid-batch reads see all writes so far; no effect fires until batch close
gist: Clause 2 — read-your-writes mid-batch: sources AND derived reads consistent; no emission until close.

name: clause 3: height-ordered propagation, exactly once, parents settled before a child sink fires
gist: Clause 3 — topological flush: exactly-once per node per commit; no sink sees a half-applied graph.

name: clause 4: a throwing effect never starves siblings; failures collect into one AggregateError
gist: Clause 4 — effects run LAST, exception-isolated; failures aggregate into ONE AggregateError.

name: clause 5: effect-issued writes drain FIFO as separate next commits
gist: Clause 5 — re-entrancy: a write inside an effect queues as the NEXT commit, FIFO; cycles hit the cap.

name: clause 5: an unbounded write cascade throws at the cycle cap, not an infinite loop
gist: Clause 5 — re-entrancy: a write inside an effect queues as the NEXT commit, FIFO; cycles hit the cap.

name: clause 6: same-origin sinks are suppressed (source AND derived); re-entrant writes carry issue-time origin
gist: Clause 6 — origin tokens: batch carries its origin; suppression is a declarative identity compare; issue-time capture for queued writes.

name: clause 7: init(snapshot) then apply per commit — no gap, no overlap
gist: Clause 7 — snapshot-then-deltas: init reflects settled state; then every commit exactly once, in order.

name: clause 7: sink()/connect() attached INSIDE batch() — init is the settled commit, apply starts at the NEXT commit
gist: Clause 7 addendum (SCHEDULE_VERSION 4) — an attach INSIDE an open batch() observes the batch boundary: the whole attach defers to that batch's commit. Pre-v4 the init snapshot read the half-applied batch (read-your-writes) and apply() then redelivered the same batch — a mid-batch subscriber double-counted every pending write.

name: clause 8: A→B→A and add+remove annihilate; multi-write batches consolidate to one delta per key
gist: Clause 8 — emission legality: consolidation ≤1 delta/key; net-zero flips annihilate to NOTHING.

name: clause 10a: remove(key, path) deletes the field; the delta is a deleted-marked update
gist: Clause 10a — nested-field removal: property deleted, delta carries deleted:true, no phantom.

name: clause 10b: every absent-target remove is a silent no-op, never a throw or a write
gist: Clause 10b — removes are idempotent everywhere: non-live key, absent ancestor, un-owned leaf.

name: clause 10c: vivify-under-null/scalar on live rows; deep write to a non-live key throws
gist: Clause 10c — deep writes vivify under null/scalar on LIVE rows; stay loud on dead keys.

name: clause 8: same-batch field-write/field-delete merges — annihilate, keep-delete, drop-marker, restore
gist: Clause 8 × 10a — same-batch field-write + field-delete consolidation. The four merge shapes recordUpdate implements; a regression in the keeps-the-marker branch would emit the exact update-to-undefined shape clause 10a outlaws.

name: clause 10d: a poison record never aborts its siblings; rejects collect into one AggregateError
gist: Clause 10d — ingest isolates per record: siblings commit, rejects surface after the flush.

name: clause 9: coalescing changes commit COUNT, never semantics — default stays sync per chunk
gist: Clause 9 — coalescing is opt-in sugar: same final state, fewer commits; default stays sync.

name: clause 11: NUL/unicode keys are total; undefined/NaN are first-class; by-ref values are shared-immutable
gist: Clause 11 — the value-domain portability table: NUL keys, first-class NaN/undefined, by-ref immutability.
